fields.Name: T222 - Resource Access Lookup Requires Type And ID
fields.Description: Exercises the client-side required-field guard in OnLookupResource ('Resource type and resource ID are both required.') before any engine call. This is a distinct validation-block behavior, data-agnostic, and separate from the successful-lookup path.

InputDefinition.goal: You are logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the Permissions app via the application switcher next to the logo, then click 'Resource Access' in the left nav. Pages can take 10-30s to load — wait, don't navigate away. Without filling in the 'Resource Type:' combobox and 'Resource ID:' field (leave at least one blank), click the 'Lookup' button. Success is that the lookup is BLOCKED with a validation error message stating that resource type and resource ID are both required (an error alert appears at the top of the page) — the grantee results table does NOT appear. Seeing the guard prevent the empty lookup with a clear message is success.

judgeValidationCriteria: Clicking 'Lookup' with a blank Resource Type and/or Resource ID surfaces a validation error message indicating both fields are required
No grantee results table is shown for the empty/invalid lookup
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages (the validation notice is expected and is not a crash)
